name: uicockpit
description: The CLI of the UIcockpit design system generator. Two ways in: AUDIT a codebase you already wrote and derive the design system it implies, or apply a kit you configured — then ENFORCE it anywhere: audit -> apply -> check, and FORGE: describe a component and the four-layer derivation says whether it may exist, with a citation. The verifier nobody else ships.
author: Alexander Kaan
